verdict.reasoning: This object describes one symmetric reversal setup, not two welded opposite trades: the same core logic is used in either direction depending on the context-selected liquidity grab—price breaks support/resistance, performs a fakeout, then reverses, and the trader enters at the candle that made the grab. The object itself frames long vs short as alternatives ('either sell-side liquidity or buy side liquidity whichever you prefer to trade'), with side-specific but mirrored execution rules: stop below the grab for longs / above for shorts, and target a recent high for longs / a recent low for shorts. Those are not simultaneous requirements for one trade instance; they are direction-dependent mirrors of the same setup, so a single trade can coherently satisfy all conditions once the bullish or bearish case is selected.
